theorem QOU.MathlibExt.abs_corrected_trapezoid_sub_integral_le_osc {g g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b D : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hg : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g (g₁ x) x) (hg1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g₁ (g₂ x) x) (hc2 : ContinuousOn g₂ (Set.uIcc a b)) (hD : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, |g₂ x - g₂ a| ≤ D) :
|(b - a) / 2 * (g a + g b) - (b - a) ^ 2 / 12 * (g₁ b - g₁ a) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, g x| ≤ (b - a) ^ 3 * D / 12

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.abs_integral_weight_sq_deriv2_mul_le {g₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b D : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc2 : ContinuousOn g₂ (Set.uIcc a b)) (hD : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, |g₂ x - g₂ a| ≤ D) :
|∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, (12 * (x - a) ^ 2 - 12 * (b - a) * (x - a) + 2 * (b - a) ^ 2) * g₂ x| ≤ 2 * (b - a) ^ 3 * D

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.integral_eq_corrected_trapezoid_sub_deriv2 {g g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hg : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g (g₁ x) x) (hg1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g₁ (g₂ x) x) (hc2 : ContinuousOn g₂ (Set.uIcc a b)) :
∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, g x = (b - a) / 2 * (g a + g b) - (b - a) ^ 2 / 12 * (g₁ b - g₁ a) + 1 / 24 * ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, (12 * (x - a) ^ 2 - 12 * (b - a) * (x - a) + 2 * (b - a) ^ 2) * g₂ x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.abs_weight_sq_deriv2_le {a b x : ℝ} (_hab : a ≤ b) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
|12 * (x - a) ^ 2 - 12 * (b - a) * (x - a) + 2 * (b - a) ^ 2| ≤ 2 * (b - a) ^ 2

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.integral_weight_sq_mul_deriv4_eq {g₂ g₃ g₄ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hg2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g₂ (g₃ x) x) (hg3 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g₃ (g₄ x) x) (hc2 : ContinuousOn g₂ (Set.uIcc a b)) (hc4 : ContinuousOn g₄ (Set.uIcc a b)) :
∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, (x - a) ^ 2 * (b - x) ^ 2 * g₄ x = ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, (12 * (x - a) ^ 2 - 12 * (b - a) * (x - a) + 2 * (b - a) ^ 2) * g₂ x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.abs_corrected_trapezoid_sub_integral_le {f f' f'' f''' f'''' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b M : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' x) x) (hf'' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' x) x) (hf''' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f''' (f'''' x) x) (hcont : ContinuousOn f'''' (Set.uIcc a b)) (hM : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, |f'''' x| ≤ M) :
|(b - a) / 2 * (f a + f b) - (b - a) ^ 2 / 12 * (f' b - f' a) - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x| ≤ (b - a) ^ 5 * M / 720

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.integral_eq_corrected_trapezoid_sub {f f' f'' f''' f'''' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hf' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' x) x) (hf'' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' x) x) (hf''' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f''' (f'''' x) x) (hcont : ContinuousOn f'''' (Set.uIcc a b)) :
∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x = (b - a) / 2 * (f a + f b) - (b - a) ^ 2 / 12 * (f' b - f' a) + 1 / 24 * ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, (x - a) ^ 2 * (b - x) ^ 2 * f'''' x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.integral_weight_sq (a b : ℝ) :
